name: php-dev-server
description: Local PHP development server for HairLook (dev). Start with system PHP or XAMPP's PHP binary.
notes: If running under XAMPP/Apache prefer using XAMPP Control Panel and place repo under htdocs.
For XAMPP's PHP binary, replace 'php' with full path, e.g. "C:\\xampp\php\php.exe"
This server is intended for quick local API/endpoint testing only (not for production).
Import the DB before running tests: mysql -u root -p hairlook < "DB Hairlook\hairlook.sql"
